COD.note: The report's finding that only Angola has a general law is about Central Africa; the document names no law status for the DRC itself.

facts.fact: A report presented on 20 November 2026 by RPDH with Transparency International says Congo lacks a general access to information framework, and that only Angola in Central Africa has a general law on the subject.
